---
title: "`r params$study_name` - Sample Size Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
output: pdf_document
params:
  study_name: NULL
  study_notes: NULL
  sample_size_table: NULL
  cluster_table: NULL
  conditions: NULL
  trial_type: NULL
  outcome_type: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(knitr)
```

## Report Overview

This report summarises the estimated sample sizes for a **two-arm `r tolower(params$trial_type)` randomised controlled trial**, based on the specific assumptions detailed below. 

> *Disclaimer: Figures are advisory and should be independently verified by a qualified statistician before use in trial protocols or grant applications. For questions, contact Alexander.Perkins@LSHTM.ac.uk.*

---

```{r notes_cond, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Conditionally render the notes section if the user provided text
if (!is.null(params$study_notes) && nchar(trimws(params$study_notes)) > 0) {
  cat("### Study Notes\n\n", params$study_notes, "\n\n---\n\n")
}
```

### Trial Parameters

**Trial Design:** `r params$trial_type` RCT  
**Outcome Type:** `r params$outcome_type`

```{r parameters, echo=FALSE}
cond_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(params$conditions),
  Value = as.character(unlist(params$conditions, use.names = FALSE))
)
kable(cond_df, row.names = FALSE)
```

---

### Total Sample Size (Adjusted)

This table displays the realistic recruited sample size required across both arms, accounting for your specified parameters and expected loss to follow-up. 

```{r sample_size_table, echo=FALSE}
kable(params$sample_size_table)
```

```{r cluster_table_cond, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (params$trial_type == "Cluster") {
  cat("---\n\n### Total Number of Clusters\n\nThis table displays the total number of clusters required across both arms (ensuring 1:1 allocation balance).\n\n")
  print(kable(params$cluster_table))
}
```
